question: It’s surprising that Daphne, who tried to reduce humankind’s numbers, and Minerva, who tries to heal people, get along so well.
answer: As long as they both accept that “That’s just the way it is.”, they get along better than you’d expect. It’s not like they dislike each other’s personality. On top of that, Minerva doesn’t try to accompany the ‘dead’. (Note: Not really sure on ‘accompany’ here.)
